people.name: Gedaliah
people.line: Son of Pashhur; an official during Zedekiah's reign.

people.name: Jehucal
people.line: An official during Zedekiah's reign, opposed Jeremiah.

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

people.name: Malchiah
people.line: Son of Pashur, involved in plot against Jeremiah.

people.name: Mattan
people.line: Father of Shephatiah, an opponent of Jeremiah.

people.name: Pashhur
people.line: Priest sent by Zedekiah to inquire of Jeremiah

people.name: Pashhur
people.line: Son of Gedaliah, an official who opposed Jeremiah

translations.web: Shephatiah the son of Mattan, and Gedaliah the son of Pashhur, and Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashhur the son of Malchijah, heard the words that Jeremiah spoke to all the people, saying,
translations.bsb: Now Shephatiah son of Mattan, Gedaliah son of Pashhur, Jucal son of Shelemiah, and Pashhur son of Malchijah heard that Jeremiah had been telling all the people:
translations.kjv: Then Shephatiah the son of Mattan, and Gedaliah the son of Pashur, and Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashur the son of Malchiah, heard the words that Jeremiah had spoken unto all the people, saying,
translations.asv: And Shephatiah the son of Mattan, and Gedaliah the son of Pashhur, and Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashhur the son of Malchijah, heard the words that Jeremiah spake unto all the people, saying,
